verdict.rationale: The California Franchise Tax Board runs public-facing web services (MyFTB, Web Pay), so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no MCP server or other agent-connection surface. The only probes recorded are Akamai 403 denials at the front-door robots.txt and at the filing/payment application host, which show keyless agents being blocked, not an agent integration offered.
